test_scope: Synthetic mixed-content HTML and URL-policy checks were executed offline on the implementation candidate immediately before commit. No external network access was used.
design_guards: Query strings and fragments rejected, including result-specific query variants.
Mixed source HTML remains in memory and is not emitted as evidence.
Only strict PRE allowlist fields plus SHA-256 provenance are written.
Day1 is not inferred from race ID/date pattern; positive page association is required.
Tool itself never authorizes support increment or RESULT join.
